boundaries: Labels are read from EN Format, never guessed from card names. Older Iron Treads ex without the Future label stays non-Future.
Pokémon family labels do not imply Rule Boxes; existing Rule Box and prize data stay unchanged.
Battle Style tags are preserved for Trainers and Energy using battleStyles, without assigning Pokemon families to non-Pokemon cards.
Ancient/Future non-Pokemon card tags and effects requiring them are not modeled by Pokemon families and remain unsupported.
Only complete recognized components become supported; other effects on the same card may keep it unsupported.
